CISO.capacity_proxy_rule: Maximum hourly net generation observed in the window for the fuel (DERIVED). A proxy for installed capacity, not nameplate: it understates fleets that never ran flat out and includes storage in OTH.

evening_ramp.definition: (net load at 20:00 local - net load at 16:00 local) / 4 h, net load = demand - solar - wind, per day
